findings.subject: page: dashboard-page
findings.summary: `atom63 copy dashboard-page` (and `atom63 template dashboard-page`) leave out pages/list-page/list-page-data.ts, which the page imports, so the copied dashboard does not compile.
findings.evidence: dashboard-page.tsx:13 imports '../list-page/list-page-data'. `pnpm -s atom63 copy dashboard-page <scratch>` wrote 7 files (app-shell, activity-list, data-table-section, empty-state, page-header, stat-row, dashboard-page) and no list-page-data.ts; a relative-import scan reported 'UNRESOLVED dashboard-page.tsx -> ../list-page/list-page-data'. `atom63 template dashboard-page` prints the same file set. The shadcn item apps/docs/public/r/dashboard-page.json does include it, so only the CLI path is broken. cli.test.mjs:127-145 checks copy for list-page only.
findings.fix: Make the CLI's dependency walk follow every relative import (not only blocks/*), or move the sample invoices into a shared data file the catalog declares; extend the copy test in packages/cli/src/cli.test.mjs to every catalog entry.

verified.reason: Reproduced. packages/templates/src/pages/dashboard-page/dashboard-page.tsx:13 imports '../list-page/list-page-data'. `pnpm -s atom63 copy dashboard-page <scratch>` wrote only 7 files (dashboard-page plus 6 blocks) and no pages/list-page/list-page-data.ts. `atom63 template dashboard-page` lists only blocks (activity-list, app-shell, data-table-section, page-header, stat-row). So the copied page has an unresolved import and does not compile, which fails Y5 ('the copy works') for a page marked readiness 'ready'.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Nothing leads a builder to ReaderLayout: `atom63 build` for a docs or article idea never names it (it suggests compact density and list-page), there is no example, and the docs mention it in one snippet.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 build "a docs article page with a table of contents"` -> Compact density, list-page, chat-page, dashboard-page, data-table-section; Foundation lists Page, Container, Section, SectionHeader only. `atom63 build "a blog post reading layout"` -> app-view. `atom63 example reader-layout` -> component.not_found. apps/docs/src/pages/pattern-layout.mdx:51 is the only mention.
findings.fix: Add ReaderLayout to the build kit's Foundation list and to the reading/docs/article intent; document its props (aside, reserveAside) and when to use it on pattern-layout; make its story reachable by `atom63 example`. Also stop 'table of contents' from triggering compact density.

verified.reason: The gap is real but the finding overstates it. `atom63 build "a docs article page with a table of contents"` does return compact density, list-page, chat-page, dashboard-page, data-table-section and no ReaderLayout. `atom63 search article` and `atom63 search docs` do not surface it either, and `atom63 example reader-layout` gives component.not_found. But 'nothing leads a builder to it' is wrong: `atom63 search reader` returns `api ReaderLayout`, `atom63 api ReaderLayout` prints the import and points to `atom63 docs pattern-layout`, and apps/docs/src/components/docs-page.tsx uses it. ReaderLayout is a layout primitive, not a template, so `copy` does not apply, and a builder can still put together a reading column from Container/Section. It is a gap a builder can hit (P2), not a blocker for 'ready'.

findings.subject: all page templates and blocks except list-page
findings.summary: Only list-page has tablet (768) and wide (1440) baselines; the other 6 pages and 13 blocks are captured at 390 and 1280 only, so the md breakpoint where the sidebar, panel and tab bar switch is never seen.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/.storybook/visual.setup.ts:18-32: viewportForStory returns 390 for ids ending '-phone', 768/1024/1440 only for 'templates-pages-list-page--*', else 1280. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ has no *-tablet or *-wide file for any other template.
findings.fix: Add Tablet and Wide stories (tabletGlobals/wideGlobals exist in story-matrix.tsx:51-54) to every page template, and widen viewportForStory to any '-tablet'/'-wide' story id; have check:templates require them for ready templates.

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: AppView's own phone stories (PhoneWithTabBar, PhoneWithDockedBar, PhoneWithOverlay) are baselined at 1280 wide, so the component has no phone-width visual evidence.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-appview-phone-with-tab-bar-chromium-linux.png is 1280x900 with the track list across the full width; apps/storybook/.storybook/visual.setup.ts:18-32 only matches ids ending in '-phone'.
findings.fix: Give those stories phone globals and size any story with a phone viewport global (not only the '-phone' suffix) at 390 in visual.setup.ts; add a 768 story for the panel/tab-bar switch.

findings.subject: page: list-page / block: data-table-section
findings.summary: Column breakpoints are viewport media queries though documented as table width, and list-page hides Amount (the key number) at tablet while showing Issued.
findings.evidence: data-table-section.tsx:24 doc 'The table width at which this column first appears' vs lines 58-61 'hidden md:table-cell' / 'hidden lg:table-cell'; list-page.tsx:72-83 Issued showFrom md, Amount showFrom lg; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/templates-pages-list-page-tablet-chromium-linux.png shows no Amount column with free space before the row actions.
findings.fix: Use container queries (@container on the table frame) so showFrom means table width, fix the doc either way, and give Amount priority over Issued in the list-page sample.

findings.subject: page: app-view
findings.summary: The phone sample pads its first block with raw env(safe-area-inset-top), bypassing the --a63-safe-area-top variable the AppView frame and hosts use, and no story checks it.
findings.evidence: packages/templates/src/pages/app-view/app-view.tsx:275 `pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)]`; the frame reads var(--a63-safe-area-top, env(...)) (app-view.css:11); environment.native.css:8 defines the variable a native host or test overrides. EdgeToEdgePhone (app-view.stories.tsx:24-27) has no checkSafeArea play, unlike chat-page.stories.tsx:52-59.
findings.fix: Use pt-[var(--a63-safe-area-top)] (or expose --a63-app-view-inset-top for the first block) and add a checkSafeArea play to EdgeToEdgePhone.

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: With chrome='inset' and topBarSpan='main', the rail and panel run to the top of the window with no top safe-area inset; only flush chrome pads them, and the frame check never looks at rail or panel.
findings.evidence: app-view.css:207-214 apply the top inset to rail/panel only under [data-chrome='flush'][data-top-bar-span='main']; inset chrome gives the root only space-2 (line 150). checkFrame (app-view.stories.tsx:152-160) checks edges top-bar, main, bottom-bar, tab-bar only.
findings.fix: Give rail and panel padding-block-start: max(space-2, inset-top) for topBarSpan=main in inset chrome too, and add rail/panel to checkFrame's owners with an inset-chrome TopBarOverMain story.

findings.subject: page: app-view
findings.summary: The phone sample shrinks text with text-sm/text-xs, which the build kit for phone screens tells builders not to do.
findings.evidence: app-view.tsx:249-250 (bottom bar title/subtitle text-sm/text-xs) and 277 (album meta text-sm); `atom63 build "a phone app home screen with tabs"`: 'keep rows and labels on the defaults or the text roles (text-body, text-subhead, text-footnote) instead of shrinking them with text-sm or text-xs'.
findings.fix: Use text-subhead/text-footnote roles in AppViewPhonePage so the copied sample follows the phone form factor.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: ReaderLayout's only example teaches code that breaks two AGENTS.md rules (ring focus, nested bordered card), and check:craft does not scan stories.
findings.evidence: reader-layout.stories.tsx:51 `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2` (rule 12: outline); lines 50-63 a bordered link with a bordered, bg-muted/30 header instead of Card (rule 7); scripts/design-system/check-craft.mjs:56 excludes *.stories.tsx.
findings.fix: Rebuild the example cards with Card and outline focus; consider running the craft rules over stories that `atom63 example` serves.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: The aside (page navigation) vanishes below 1280 with no fallback, the article's xl:max-w-4xl can never apply, and no story shows a width other than 1280.
findings.evidence: reader-layout.tsx:36 'hidden w-64 shrink-0 ... xl:block'; line 23 max-w-5xl (64rem) vs line 26 xl:max-w-4xl (56rem) + 16rem aside = 72rem, so the article is held to 48rem by the frame; stories have no viewport globals and baselines are 1280 only.
findings.fix: Document or provide the narrow-width fallback (e.g. an inline TOC slot), remove or correct the inert max width, and add phone/tablet stories.

findings.subject: block: stat-row
findings.summary: A long value overflows its card on a phone: two fixed columns with a 24px value and no wrapping or shrink.
findings.evidence: stat-row.tsx:33 grid-cols-2 (minmax(0,1fr)), :39 `text-2xl ... tabular-nums` with no min-w-0/break/clamp; estimated ~139px content width per card at 390 vs ~145px for '$1,248,200'. No long-value story.
findings.fix: Let values wrap or step down (e.g. text-xl below sm, or break-all on the dd), and add a LongValues story.

findings.subject: block: activity-list
findings.summary: ActivityList has no empty case: with no items it renders an empty list and nothing explains it.
findings.evidence: activity-list.tsx:40-58 maps items into <ol> with no length check; dashboard-page feeds it unguarded.
findings.fix: Render the empty-state block (or a one-line 'No activity yet') when items is empty, with a story.

findings.subject: all page templates and blocks
findings.summary: No template has a long-text or many-items stress story; edge cases exist only for list-page, sign-in, filter-bar, data-table-section and chat.
findings.evidence: Story exports across packages/templates/src: 20x Desktop, 20x Phone, 20x Themes; extra cases only Empty*/NoInvoices/Progress*/Success*/Selected* (list-page), NoResults, Filtered, MissingEmail, WrongPassword, StartScreen, Streaming. None with long names, long titles or 50+ rows.
findings.fix: Add a shared stress fixture (long names, long titles, many rows, one item) and a Stress story per page template; have check:templates require it for ready templates.

findings.subject: block: tab-bar
findings.summary: The tab bar label size is a literal 11px, the only arbitrary value in the templates, so it ignores the phone type roles and the type-scale preference.
findings.evidence: tab-bar.tsx:58 `text-[0.6875rem]`; grep for arbitrary values across packages/templates/src finds only this one.
findings.fix: Use a token-backed role (e.g. a caption/footnote step) or add a tab-label token, and look it up with `atom63 token`.

findings.subject: atom63 build (all templates)
findings.summary: `atom63 build` pads results with unrelated pages and components, so the right template is often one of several.
findings.evidence: 'a sign in page' -> sign-in-page, chat-page, dashboard-page; 'a settings screen' -> settings-page, chat-page; 'an admin dashboard' -> components carousel, chat-composer, chat-steps; 'a docs article page with a table of contents' -> compact density + list-page.
findings.fix: Raise the match threshold for pages and components so weak matches are dropped, and stop 'table' in 'table of contents' from triggering compact density.

findings.subject: Page / Section
findings.summary: Page and Section have no stories of their own, so their responsive padding presets are never captured at any width.
findings.evidence: No *.stories.tsx in packages/ui-react/src/layout uses Page/Section except reader-layout.stories.tsx (spacing='tight' only); no baseline for them in apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/.
findings.fix: Add a layout story showing each Section spacing preset inside Page at phone, tablet and wide.

findings.subject: block: getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: Only one progress state is shown; done-all and single-step states are not exercised.
findings.evidence: getting-started-checklist.stories.tsx exports Desktop, Phone, Themes only; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/templates-pages-onboarding-page-desktop shows '0 of 3 done'.
findings.fix: Add PartlyDone and AllDone stories (and what the block shows when every step is finished).

findings.subject: block: detail-panel
findings.summary: Long field values have no overflow handling and no story.
findings.evidence: detail-panel.tsx has no truncate/min-w-0/break-words (grep); stories Desktop, Phone, Themes only.
findings.fix: Add break-words/min-w-0 on values and a long-value story.

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: Section spacing presets are not monotonic and the top padding is removed by default.
findings.evidence: section.tsx:29-35 gap: loose space-y-8 but generous space-y-6; :18 removeTopSpacing = true.
findings.fix: Make gaps rise with the preset; keep or reconsider the removeTopSpacing default (documented in pattern-layout).

findings.subject: block: detail-panel
findings.summary: The detail sheet opens on the physical right, which is the start side in RTL.
findings.evidence: detail-panel.tsx:49 side="right"; sheet.css:45-48 keeps left/right physical in RTL.
findings.fix: Add an inline-end side to Sheet or pick the side from the direction in the block.

findings.subject: AppView / block: tab-bar
findings.summary: In inset chrome the tab bar's negative margins cancel the root's inline safe-area padding as well as the space-2 gutter.
findings.evidence: app-view.css:181-184 margin-inline: calc(-1 * max(space-2, inset-inline)); tab-bar.tsx:46-47 adds no inline padding.
findings.fix: Pad the tab bar's inline edges with the inline inset after the negative margin.

findings.subject: page: sign-in-page / Page
findings.summary: Bare Page (sign-in) owns no safe-area inset; it works only because the card is narrow and centered.
findings.evidence: sign-in-page.tsx:76 `<Page className="flex items-center px-4">`; page.tsx:16 pads pt-8 pb-20 only.
findings.fix: Pad Page's inline and block edges with max(gutter, --a63-safe-area-*) when it is the outermost frame, or document that the route owns them.

findings.subject: page: onboarding-page
findings.summary: The same 'Create your first invoice' action appears twice on the first-run page (empty-state primary and the current checklist step).
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/templates-pages-onboarding-page-desktop-chromium-linux.png.
findings.fix: YZ to decide whether the checklist's current step repeats the action or only points to it.
